messages:
maria: Quick Q — planning to flip the feature flag `soft-capacity-window` for burst queueing in canary (~5% traffic) tonight at 23:00 UTC. Any concerns about the guardrail thresholds? Need to confirm `max_concurrency` fallback and `queue_threshold` before flip. cc @kevin @dan

kevin: Heads-up noted. Main risk is long-tail when sequence_length spikes. My recommendation: `max_concurrency: 40`, `queue_threshold_ms: 1200`, `abort_after_queue_ms: 5000`. Also add `fallback_model: rwd-13b-q4` so we have a low-cost runway. Example rollout config:

```yaml
flag: soft-capacity-window
scope: canary
audience: 5%
params:
  max_concurrency: 40
  queue_threshold_ms: 1200
  abort_after_queue_ms: 5000
  fallback_model: rwd-13b-q4
```

This should keep p95 latency delta <15% in our perf sims.

dan: PR #4521 is open with the runtime change and unit + integration tests. Need approvals from eng-runtime before we flip. I also added a note about KV cache retention for fallback paths. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4521

sara: I can add a small canary dashboard (p50/p95/p99 latency, queue_length, retry_rate, fallback_rate). Will post the dashboard link in ~30m. Also request a smokecheck run post-flip.

maria: thanks — can someone run a dry toggle in staging before prod? want to validate the fallback behavior and abort path.

kevin: did a dry toggle in staging earlier, logs looked clean and fallback triggered once when we forced a long seq. I'll coordinate the staging->prod schedule with @deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle `soft-capacity-window` -> enabled for canary (5%) at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z by kevin. Will run smokechecks and post results to this thread.

maria: perfect. tagging this as resolved unless someone objects by EOD. :thumbsup:
